notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Terrarium Lovers!

Thanks for playing Mini Gardens!

We've just released an update with these changes:
* Improvements in the performance of the game
* Added an option to disable post-processing

if you still have performance issues, please let me know.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Terrarium Lovers!

Thanks for playing Mini Gardens!

We've just released an update with these changes:
* Adjustment on the Hitbox size to delete a link
* New Achievements icons
* Improvements on tutorial after level 4
* Level indicator on the lower right corner
* Adjustment  on the Hitbox in the level selector
* Music and SFX volumes now starts on 70% and 90%


We've made the changes thanks to your suggestions and feedback. They are very welcome.
